title: Weather Controller
keywords: Changes Time, Rain or Thunder after its powered/redstone-driven operation completes

blocks.text: Changes Time, Rain or Thunder after its powered/redstone-driven operation completes.

rows: Choose the mode and desired state.
Supply FE and a redstone signal.
Maintain power through the configured operating duration, then allow its cooldown.

blocks.text: Unlike many ordinary machines, no redstone signal means no operation. If the world already has the target state, another change may be unnecessary.
